name: board_performance
description: Get partner voting board performance: revenue from boards, order count, AOV, vote rate (people who finished voting / people invited), and funnel counts for a time period. Opened = boards with at least one voter who opened. Voted = boards with at least one voter done. Early funnel (button seen, saved) comes from storefront tracking.

name: top_shared_products
description: Get the most shared products on voting boards: product title, GID, board count, and percent loved by voters

name: product_partner_feedback
description: Get voter reactions for a specific product: loved, maybe, not for us counts (counting every voter's vote) and percent loved. Requires 5+ votes.

name: orders_from_boards
description: Get recent orders that came from shared voting boards: order number, date, amount, pieces, loved count. No customer info.

name: shares_by_channel
description: Get board share counts by channel (WhatsApp, Email, SMS, Copy link, Share sheet) and vote rate per channel (boards with at least one voter done)

name: notification_health
description: Get voting-done email health: sent, pending, failed counts and whether Klaviyo is connected

name: top_board_customers
description: Only use when the merchant asks about their customers (top customers, repeat buyers, who ordered from boards). Returns customer name, board orders, revenue, repeat buyer status, and admin link. Never returns email, phone, or address.

repeat_only.description: Only show repeat buyers (2+ board orders all-time)

name: partner_reasons
description: Get why voters chose Maybe or Pass: reason counts for each verdict (counting every voter's reason). Use to identify product feedback patterns.

name: group_voting_stats
description: Get group voting statistics: boards by voter count (1, 2-3, 4-5), percent group boards, average voters per board, vote rate by group size, percent with prices hidden, percent with group links. Numbers only, no voter names.
